sections.description: Prepared independent reference and stored raw TAC-channel tail.

buttons.label: Run headlessly
buttons.description: Use the stored tail to calculate and archive this independent reference without opening the interactive calculator.

buttons.label: Open calculator
buttons.description: Open the existing native G-factor calculator to inspect and edit the reference, background, tail and mixing.

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.description: Discard the prepared reference and retain all previous detector calibration values.

buttons.label: Apply calibration and close
buttons.description: Finish pending computation, archive the completed reference and apply its G, actual SD, mixing and provenance to the selected detector.

buttons.label: Discard calibration
buttons.description: Close the calculator without archiving or changing the detector.
